title: Data-Efficient Conformalized Interval Prediction of Minimum Operating Voltage Capturing Process Variations
problem: Conventional Vmin prediction methods lack coverage guarantees for interval predictions. Standard Conformal Prediction predictors fail when process variations are unknown, limiting their applicability to manufacturing test scenarios.
motivation: Accurate Vmin prediction is critical for semiconductor manufacturing tests and ensuring chip reliability and yield.
method: The paper proposes a distribution-free Conformal Prediction approach that explicitly models process variations for data-efficient Vmin interval prediction. The method utilizes calibration data from a small set of additional chips to learn variation characteristics. A machine learning predictor generates prediction intervals with conformalized coverage guarantees. This approach combines data efficiency with rigorous statistical guarantees on interval coverage.
key_novelty: Applying distribution-free Conformal Prediction with explicit process variation modeling to achieve data-efficient Vmin interval prediction with guaranteed coverage.
contributions: Application of Conformal Prediction to Vmin prediction incorporating process variation awareness
Data-efficient calibration approach requiring only a few additional chips
Rigorous coverage guarantees for interval predictions in manufacturing contexts
Validation on industrial 16nm semiconductor manufacturing data
limitations: Not discussed in the provided abstract.
primary_theme: Data-efficient voltage prediction with statistical guarantees
